finalText:
**Fixed the pagination bug.** All 5 tests pass in 73ms.

`paginate` started each page at `page * perPage`, but pages are 1-indexed. Page 1 skipped the first batch, page 2 skipped two, and so on. It now starts at `(page - 1) * perPage`.

One note: running `node --test tests/` on this Node version reports a failure even though every test passes. Use `node --test tests/paginate.test.js` for real results.
